about: Classes: adventuring callings that a member of an ancestry can take. specializations are traits of category specialization that the class may choose (a mage school, a cleric domain); their spells come with the choice. Creatures that are not people are species, not classes. A class with adventuring false (commoner) is ordinary life rather than a calling, open to every ancestry.

fighter.name: Fighter
fighter.description: Hardy front line; sweeping weapon blows.

source.notes: Kyr chassis: hit die 8, not 12; no proficiencies or Orsino warrior abilities.

cleric.name: Cleric
cleric.description: Divine support; healing, blessing, and purification.

source.notes: Kyr chassis: hit die 6, not 8; Kyr spells; no spell slots.

magic_user.name: Magic-user
magic_user.description: Fragile scholar; limited but powerful magic.

source.notes: Kyr chassis: hit die 4; Kyr spells; no spell slots or spellbook picks.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Trail guide; patient approaches to receptive wildlife.

commoner.name: Commoner
commoner.description: Untrained work, travel, and basic self-defense.
